answer: A proof-of-inference protocol curbs Sybil attacks through low-latency neural generation challenges. Verifiers issue dynamic prompts demanding a structured sonnet constrained by a jade theme and precise rhyme scheme. Adversaries cannot ripple batch queries across shared hardware without missing tight latency deadlines, forcing them to dedicate scarce physical GPU cores per identity. However, variable network jitter can falsely disqualify honest nodes with high transit latency.
